## History

Carrie Sloane is a classmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). She attended a party with her peers where [Josie Pye](../character/josie-pye.md) dared [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to walk the ridgepole of the [Barry](../character/barry.md) kitchen roof.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII.
